theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_liou_chain_vanish
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K C : ℝ) (S : Set (Rn n → Rn ℓ)) (W : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < α → α < 1 → 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ C → (∀ V ∈ S, ContDiff ℝ 1 V) → (∀ V ∈ S, ∀ v : Rn n, (fun x => fderiv ℝ V x v) ∈ S) → (∀ V ∈ S, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∀ c : Rn ℓ, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ V x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C / ρ ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (2 * ρ), ‖V x - c‖ₑ ^ 2) → W ∈ S → (∀ x : Rn n, ‖fderiv ℝ W x - fderiv ℝ W 0‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ α) → ∀ u w y : Rn n, fderiv ℝ ((fun g : Rn n → Rn ℓ => fun z => fderiv ℝ g z u)^[n] (fun z => fderiv ℝ W z w)) y = 0
